title: Cursed Altar
description: A black stone altar squats in a chamber lit by guttering green flames that burn without fuel. Old blood stains its surface in concentric rings, and dark energy pulses from deep within the stone in a slow, rhythmic throb like a second heartbeat. Small offerings — coins, trinkets, a severed hand — are arrayed around its base.

choices.label: Take the cursed relic
choices.description: A blackened artifact rests at the altar's center, thrumming with power.

choices.label: Harvest the altar dust
choices.description: The residue of countless rituals has left a thick layer of potent grave dust.

choices.label: Search the offerings
choices.description: The faithful left coin and trinket alike at the altar's feet.

choices.label: Back away slowly
choices.description: Cursed altars are best left to their dark purpose.
